Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 is Project Assistant. This is a contractual government job opportunity at a prestigious institution.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Assistant at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post at the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee. Interested candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant position at IIT Roorkee is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Candidates must report on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Assistant post must possess a Diploma in Civil Engineering. This is the essential qualification for eligibility.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Project Assistant position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant post will receive a salary of Rs. 49500 Per Month. This is a competitive salary for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date and venue.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Roorkee Project Assistant recruitment. It is completely free to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Project Assistant at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position at IIT Roorkee primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with pincode 247667. This is the location for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs for the walk-in interview. Refer to the official notification for a complete list.
